args: for app in /Applications/BreezeType.app "$HOME/Applications/BreezeType.app" "$(/usr/bin/mdfind "kMDItemCFBundleIdentifier == 'com.pais.breeze.dev'" 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/head -n 1)"; do launcher="$app/Contents/Resources/resources/scripts/mcp/breeze-mcp"; if [ -x "$launcher" ]; then exec "$launcher"; fi; done; echo 'BreezeType is not installed. Get it at https://breezetype.com, open it once, then restart this app.' >&2; exit 1
